protocol_stack.prose: The Game of Prompts web app (static SvelteKit build, client-side routes fall back to index.html). It talks to the chain from the viewer's browser through their wallet, not through this service.

JSON REST API under /api: GET for every read (games, participations, opinions, tokens, contracts, height), POST for the reputation-opinion writes with the signer chosen by GOP_SIGNER_MODE. GET /health for liveness.
Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP transport at /mcp, stateless (no session id): the same tools, the gop://whitepaper resource and the role prompts as the stdio server.

network.prose: Ergo Explorer API over HTTPS: every on-chain Game of Prompts read (games, participations, reputation, tokens) and the UTXOs/height used to build reputation-opinion transactions. The guest gets the addresses the node resolved, not DNS; mcp/celaut.mjs maps the name to them from __config__.
The Game of Prompts whitepaper (game-of-prompts/.github profile README) served as the gop://whitepaper MCP resource, over HTTPS.

An Ergo node REST API to submit signed transactions to in GOP_SIGNER_MODE=seed (POST /transactions), on the mainnet chain the instantiator pins with ERGO_BLOCK_ID and ERGO_MIN_CUMULATIVE_DIFFICULTY. Unused in the default unsigned mode; without both variables the network is not resolved.
